تشترفن (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِفْنَ (taštarifna) /taʃ.ta.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# تُشْتَرَفْنَ (tuštarafna) /tuʃ.ta.raf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
